name: Crumb and Get It
description: Each opponent puts [c_a_food_sac] onto the battlefield. Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
assumptions: Merged the two unconnected roots C and D into a single printed effect paragraph, since this is a single-faced non-modal Instant and A is the only mechanism by which C and D could happen at all.
Rendered node C's enters as "puts onto the battlefield" rather than "creates a [token]", since token-ness couldn't be confirmed without a labels-registry entry for c_a_food_sac.
Read owner: me on the targeted modifier (D) as "target creature you control."
Read owner: opp on C with no target flag as "each opponent" (symmetric, non-targeted).
couldNotDerive: The identity of the thing entering the battlefield in node C — c_a_food_sac has no entry in the labels registry provided (its type line, subtype, stats, and even token-status are unknown); no guess was substituted.
Whether node C's permanent is freshly created or arrives from a particular zone.
notes: One real translator gap, confirmed against forge-model/data/crumb-and-get-it.txt's real oracle text ("Gift a Food (You may promise...)... Target creature you control gets +2/+2... If the gift was promised, that creature also gains indestructible until end of turn."): app/lib/forgeTranslate.ts's Pump handler only reads NumAtt$/NumDef$ (a P/T delta) — it has no handling for KW$ at all, which is how Forge encodes a Pump effect granting a KEYWORD instead of (or alongside) a stat change. The whole "if the gift was promised, also gains indestructible" clause — chained via the real spell's own SubAbility$ — was silently dropped: no node, no unmapped entry either, since 'Pump' IS a recognized effect name, just with an unhandled field on it. This is the same silent-partial-mapping class as the K:-keyword and unmapped-effect-children bugs found earlier this session, just on a field rather than a whole effect name. Separately, Gift's own always-optional nature ("you MAY promise") isn't flagged as `may` anywhere in the translated node — GiftAbility's own SVar fields carry no optionality marker (Forge hardcodes it into the K:Gift keyword mechanic itself, same as Offspring's extra-cost optionality), so the translator would need to add `may` explicitly when building a Gift node, which it currently doesn't. Also confirms the c_a_food_sac registry gap is real: synergy-model/data/registries.json (the canonical registry the examiner sees) has no Food-token entry — only the separate, app-only forge-model/pools token registry does, which the examiner correctly has no visibility into. Not retried — the KW$ gap is baked into the node data itself; a second blind read of the same packet would reproduce it identically.
